scope: Narrow review of the exact-inventory binding correction and the sealed ERROR-only download collector; no provider call, download, fit, push, or queue action was performed.
findings: The R2 correction validates that the pinned pre-download receipt's outer `output_names` list and nested provider file descriptors contain the same unique 108 names. It returns that frozen set and requires the fresh, complete session-output inventory to match it exactly before invoking the downloader; an added, missing, or duplicate name fails closed before download.

The reviewed adapter binds the downloaded file set to the fresh provider inventory, hashes each downloaded payload, rejects symlinks/unsafe names, and checks the downloaded Kaggle response-log size and SHA-256 against the fresh session-output metadata. The provider did not expose remote content hashes or sizes, so the receipt reports local hashes and does not claim remote byte identity.

The runner is restricted to the exact root-admitted terminal ERROR and bounded one-attempt download. It refuses an existing collection directory, does not push, fit, or score, and labels the result `terminal_download_complete_science_not_validated`; strict scientific validation is not run for ERROR and diagnostics explicitly say the status is execution evidence only.

tests_and_evidence.result: 3 passed in 0.47s; includes actual pinned inventory/admission validation and a missing-name rejection case
tests_and_evidence.manual_static_checks: Confirmed the exact pre-download inventory receipt has 108 outer and nested names, complete=true, and records first-page response-log SHA/size. Confirmed the ERROR code path hashes downloaded files and response.log and does not call strict-success validation.

qualification: The downloaded response.log is matched to the fresh inventory's response-log SHA/size; no claim is made that those log bytes equal the earlier read-only receipt's response-log bytes. The endpoint is not version-pinned, and remote per-file size/checksum metadata was unavailable; the exact name set, fresh endpoint metadata, local payload hashes, and lack of remote-identity evidence remain explicit.
scientific_interpretation: The root-authorized provider status is ERROR. This review does not infer a scientific model failure or success from that execution status.
